title: Google Meet Integration
description: Connect a Google Workspace account so admins can create Google Meet sessions directly from the live-class wizard. Learners join by opening the Meet link (Google Meet has no in-app embed).

errors.connectionStartFailed: Could not start the Google connection. Please try again.

recordingNotice.text: This needs a Google Workspace account — connecting, creating meetings, and learners/host joining all work on any Workspace plan (a free personal @gmail.com account can’t use the Meet API). Auto-recording is the only paid-tier feature: it needs Business Standard+, Enterprise, or Education Plus, plus a teacher signed into the Workspace present. If you enable it on a plan that can’t record, we still create the meeting (without recording) and turn the toggle back off. Recordings land in the connected account’s Google Drive (admin-facing).
